title: Food Preservation Fermentation
note: A home-based fermented foods micro-business in Africa can start with modest equipment and scale into retail, restaurants, and export markets.

startup.item: Fermentation-grade glass jars and ceramic crocks
Air locks, bungs, and weighting stones
Digital pH meter and calibration solutions
Stainless steel work tables and shelving
Chest freezer for ingredient and product storage
Business registration, permits, and food safety certification
Initial ingredient stock (vegetables, milk, grains, salt)
